title: Minimal Hosted Pilot Architecture Decision
summary: Chooses the smallest hosted-pilot architecture posture: one bounded source API, reviewer queue, consent ledger, and read-only demo shell.
goal: Choose the smallest real backend slice without authorizing production launch.
status: Ready for founder hosted-pilot review gate
boundary: Readiness artifact only; no credentials, secrets, production storage, live AI, public telemetry, corpus delivery, public pilot, or launch authorization.
subhero: A hosted pilot should prove one source-first answer loop, not pretend the whole product is production-ready.
flow: Select only the minimum hosted slice.
Keep source API, review queue, consent, and logs separate.
Require founder review before any deployment.
decisions: Prototype on a bounded backend path only.
Do not connect payment, broad accounts, or public AI access.
Use this packet as the next founder review input.
